description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul greets the church in Corinth and thanks God for the grace given them. He rebukes the rival groups forming around leaders and declares that the message of the cross, foolishness to the world, is God's power and wisdom.
1.sw: Paulo analisalimu kanisa la Korintho na kumshukuru Mungu kwa neema waliyopewa. Anakemea makundi yanayoshindana yanayojitokeza kuwazunguka viongozi, na kutangaza kwamba ujumbe wa msalaba, ambao ni upumbavu kwa ulimwengu, ni nguvu na hekima ya Mungu.
1.am: ጳውሎስ በቆሮንቶስ ላለችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ ያቀርባል፤ ስለ ተሰጣቸው ጸጋም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል። በመሪዎች ዙሪያ የሚፈጠሩትን ተቀናቃኝ ቡድኖች ይገሥጻል፤ ለዓለም ሞኝነት የሆነው የመስቀሉ መልእክት የእግዚአብሔር ኃይልና ጥበብ እንደ ሆነም ያውጃል።

2.en: Paul came to Corinth preaching only Jesus crucified, not with clever words. God's wisdom is revealed by the Spirit, and the natural person cannot accept what the spiritual person understands.
2.sw: Paulo alikuja Korintho akihubiri Yesu aliyesulubiwa peke yake, si kwa maneno ya ujanja. Hekima ya Mungu inafunuliwa na Roho, na mtu wa kawaida hawezi kupokea yale ambayo mtu wa kiroho anayaelewa.
2.am: ጳውሎስ በብልኅ ቃላት ሳይሆን የተሰቀለውን ኢየሱስን ብቻ እየሰበከ ወደ ቆሮንቶስ መጣ። የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ በመንፈስ ይገለጣል፤ ተፈጥሮአዊው ሰው መንፈሳዊው ሰው የሚያስተውለውን ሊቀበል አይችልም።

3.en: The Corinthians are still infants, quarreling over Paul and Apollos, who are only servants. Jesus is the one foundation; they are God's temple, and whoever wants to be wise must become foolish.
3.sw: Wakorintho bado ni watoto wachanga, wakigombana juu ya Paulo na Apolo, ambao ni watumishi tu. Yesu ndiye msingi pekee; wao ni hekalu la Mungu, na yeyote anayetaka kuwa na hekima lazima awe mpumbavu.
3.am: የቆሮንቶስ ሰዎች አሁንም ሕፃናት ናቸው፤ አገልጋዮች ብቻ ስለ ሆኑት ስለ ጳውሎስና ስለ አጵሎስ ይጣላሉ። ኢየሱስ ብቸኛው መሠረት ነው፤ እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ናቸው፤ ጠቢብ መሆን የሚፈልግም ሞኝ መሆን አለበት።

4.en: Paul and his fellow workers are managers answerable to the Lord, who alone will judge. The Corinthians have nothing they were not given, and Paul warns them as a father, sending Timothy to remind them of his ways.
4.sw: Paulo na watendakazi wenzake ni mawakili wanaowajibika kwa Bwana, ambaye peke yake atahukumu. Wakorintho hawana kitu ambacho hawakupewa, naye Paulo anawaonya kama baba, akimtuma Timotheo kuwakumbusha njia zake.
4.am: ጳውሎስና የሥራ ባልደረቦቹ ለጌታ ተጠያቂ የሆኑ መጋቢዎች ናቸው፤ የሚፈርደውም እርሱ ብቻ ነው። የቆሮንቶስ ሰዎች ያልተሰጣቸው ምንም ነገር የላቸውም፤ ጳውሎስም እንደ አባት ይመክራቸዋል፤ መንገዱንም እንዲያሳስባቸው ጢሞቴዎስን ይልካል።

5.en: The church tolerates a man living with his father's wife, and Paul tells them to remove him. They must clear out the old yeast, since Jesus our Passover lamb has been sacrificed, and judge those inside the church.
5.sw: Kanisa linamvumilia mtu anayeishi na mke wa baba yake, naye Paulo anawaambia wamwondoe. Lazima waondoe hamira ya zamani, kwa kuwa Yesu, mwanakondoo wetu wa Pasaka, ametolewa dhabihu, na wawahukumu walio ndani ya kanisa.
5.am: ቤተ ክርስቲያን ከአባቱ ሚስት ጋር የሚኖረውን ሰው ታግሣለች፤ ጳውሎስም እንዲያስወግዱት ይነግራቸዋል። የፋሲካ በጋችን ኢየሱስ ስለ ታረደ አሮጌውን እርሾ ማስወገድ፣ በቤተ ክርስቲያን ውስጥ ያሉትንም መፍረድ አለባቸው።

6.en: Believers should not take each other to court before unbelievers. The wrongdoers will not inherit the kingdom, and the body belongs to the Lord, so they must flee sexual sin and honor God with their bodies.
6.sw: Waamini hawapaswi kushtakiana mahakamani mbele ya wasioamini. Watenda mabaya hawataurithi ufalme, na mwili ni mali ya Bwana, kwa hiyo lazima waukimbie uasherati na kumtukuza Mungu kwa miili yao.
6.am: አማኞች በማያምኑ ፊት እርስ በርሳቸው ፍርድ ቤት ሊካሰሱ አይገባም። ክፉ አድራጊዎች መንግሥቱን አይወርሱም፤ ሥጋም የጌታ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ከዝሙት መሸሽና በሥጋቸው እግዚአብሔርን ማክበር አለባቸው።

7.en: Paul answers questions about marriage and sexual relations, divorce, and marriage to an unbeliever. Each should remain in the calling in which they were called, and Paul gives counsel to those not married and to widows, for undivided devotion to the Lord.
7.sw: Paulo anajibu maswali kuhusu ndoa na tendo la ndoa, talaka, na kuolewa na asiyeamini. Kila mmoja anapaswa kubaki katika wito ambao aliitiwa, naye Paulo anatoa ushauri kwa wasiooa na kwa wajane, kwa ajili ya kujitoa kwa Bwana bila kugawanyika.
7.am: ጳውሎስ ስለ ጋብቻና ስለ ሩካቤ ሥጋ፣ ስለ ፍቺና የማያምን ሰውን ስለ ማግባት ለቀረቡ ጥያቄዎች መልስ ይሰጣል። እያንዳንዱ በተጠራበት ጥሪ ሊኖር ይገባዋል፤ ጳውሎስም ያልተጋቡትንና መበለቶችን ሳይከፋፈሉ ለጌታ እንዲሰጡ ይመክራቸዋል።

8.en: Knowledge puffs up but love builds up. There is one God and one Lord, so food offered to idols is nothing, yet believers must not use their freedom to make the weak fall.
8.sw: Maarifa humvimbisha mtu, lakini upendo hujenga. Kuna Mungu mmoja na Bwana mmoja, kwa hiyo chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu si kitu, lakini waamini hawapaswi kutumia uhuru wao kuwaangusha walio dhaifu.
8.am: እውቀት ያስታብያል፤ ፍቅር ግን ያንጻል። አንድ አምላክና አንድ ጌታ ስላለ ለጣዖት የተሠዋ ምግብ ምንም አይደለም፤ ሆኖም አማኞች ደካሞችን ለማሰናከል ነጻነታቸውን ሊጠቀሙበት አይገባም።

9.en: Paul has the rights of an apostle but has not used them, so as not to hinder the gospel. He has become all things to all people and disciplines himself like a runner competing for the prize.
9.sw: Paulo ana haki za mtume lakini hajazitumia, ili asiizuie Injili. Amekuwa kila kitu kwa watu wote, na kujitia nidhamu kama mkimbiaji anayeshindania tuzo.
9.am: ጳውሎስ የሐዋርያነት መብቶች አሉት፤ ወንጌልን እንዳያደናቅፍ ግን አልተጠቀመባቸውም። ለሰዎች ሁሉ ሁሉን ሆኗል፤ ለሽልማት እንደሚወዳደር ሯጭም ራሱን ይገዛል።

10.en: Israel's history in the wilderness is a warning against idolatry and grumbling, and God will not let them be tested beyond what they can bear. Believers cannot share both the Lord's table and the table of demons; whatever they do, they should do for God's glory.
10.sw: Historia ya Israeli jangwani ni onyo dhidi ya ibada ya sanamu na manung'uniko, na Mungu hatawaacha wajaribiwe kupita uwezo wao. Waamini hawawezi kushiriki meza ya Bwana na meza ya pepo pia; lolote wanalofanya, wanapaswa kulifanya kwa ajili ya utukufu wa Mungu.
10.am: የእስራኤል የምድረ በዳ ታሪክ ከጣዖት አምልኮና ከማጉረምረም የሚያስጠነቅቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከሚችሉት በላይ እንዲፈተኑ አይፈቅድም። አማኞች ከጌታ ማዕድና ከአጋንንት ማዕድ በአንድነት ሊካፈሉ አይችሉም፤ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ሊያደርጉት ይገባል።

11.en: Paul gives instructions about covering the head in worship. He rebukes the Corinthians for divisions at the Lord's Supper and hands on what he received: the bread and the cup that proclaim the Lord's death until the Lord comes.
11.sw: Paulo anatoa maagizo kuhusu kufunika kichwa wakati wa ibada. Anawakemea Wakorintho kwa mafarakano katika Chakula cha Bwana na kuwapa yale aliyoyapokea: mkate na kikombe vinavyotangaza kifo cha Bwana mpaka Bwana atakapokuja.
11.am: ጳውሎስ በአምልኮ ጊዜ ራስን ስለ መሸፈን መመሪያ ይሰጣል። በጌታ ራት ላይ ስለሚታየው መለያየት የቆሮንቶስን ሰዎች ይገሥጻል፤ የተቀበለውንም ያስተላልፍላቸዋል፤ ጌታ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የጌታን ሞት የሚያውጁትን እንጀራውንና ጽዋውን።

12.en: The one Spirit gives a variety of gifts for the common good. The church is one body with many parts, each needed by the others, and together they are the body of Jesus.
12.sw: Roho mmoja anatoa karama za aina nyingi kwa faida ya wote. Kanisa ni mwili mmoja wenye viungo vingi, kila kimoja kinahitajiwa na vingine, na kwa pamoja wao ni mwili wa Yesu.
12.am: አንዱ መንፈስ ለሁሉም ጥቅም ልዩ ልዩ ስጦታዎችን ይሰጣል። ቤተ ክርስቲያን ብዙ ብልቶች ያሉት አንድ አካል ናት፤ እያንዳንዱ ብልት ለሌሎቹ ያስፈልጋል፤ በአንድነትም የኢየሱስ አካል ናቸው።

13.en: Without love, tongues, prophecy, knowledge and faith are nothing. Love is patient and kind, and it never comes to an end, while faith, hope and love remain, and the greatest is love.
13.sw: Bila upendo, lugha, unabii, maarifa na imani si kitu. Upendo ni wenye subira na wema, na haukomi kamwe, huku imani, tumaini na upendo vikidumu, na kilicho kikuu ni upendo.
13.am: ያለ ፍቅር ልሳኖች፣ ትንቢት፣ እውቀትና እምነት ከንቱ ናቸው። ፍቅር ታጋሽና ቸር ነው፤ ከቶም አያበቃም፤ እምነት፣ ተስፋና ፍቅር ይዘልቃሉ፤ ከእነዚህም የሚበልጠው ፍቅር ነው።

14.en: Prophecy builds up the church more than tongues do, unless the tongues are interpreted. Everything in the church's meetings should be done for building up and in good order.
14.sw: Unabii unalijenga kanisa kuliko lugha, isipokuwa lugha zikitafsiriwa. Kila kitu katika mikutano ya kanisa kinapaswa kufanywa kwa ajili ya kujenga na kwa utaratibu mzuri.
14.am: ልሳኖች ካልተተረጐሙ በቀር ትንቢት ከልሳኖች ይበልጥ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ያንጻል። በቤተ ክርስቲያን ስብሰባዎች ውስጥ ሁሉም ነገር ለማነጽና በሥርዓት ሊደረግ ይገባዋል።

15.en: Paul hands on the gospel he received: Jesus died for our sins, was buried, was raised on the third day and appeared to many. If the dead are not raised, faith is futile, but Jesus is the firstfruits; the dead will be raised with a new body, and death is swallowed up in victory.
15.sw: Paulo anawapa Injili aliyoipokea: Yesu alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, akazikwa, akafufuliwa siku ya tatu na kuwatokea wengi. Ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi, imani ni bure, lakini Yesu ni malimbuko; wafu watafufuliwa wakiwa na mwili mpya, na kifo kimemezwa katika ushindi.
15.am: ጳውሎስ የተቀበለውን ወንጌል ያስተላልፋል፤ ኢየሱስ ስለ ኃጢአታችን ሞተ፣ ተቀበረ፣ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ተነሣ፣ ለብዙዎችም ተገለጠ። ሙታን የማይነሡ ከሆነ እምነት ከንቱ ነው፤ ኢየሱስ ግን በኩራት ነው፤ ሙታን በአዲስ አካል ይነሣሉ፤ ሞትም በድል ተውጧል።

16.en: Paul gives directions for the collection for God's people in Jerusalem and shares his travel plans. He urges them to stand firm and do everything in love, and closes with greetings.
16.sw: Paulo anatoa maagizo kuhusu changizo kwa ajili ya watu wa Mungu walioko Yerusalemu na kueleza mipango yake ya safari. Anawahimiza kusimama imara na kufanya kila kitu kwa upendo, na kumalizia kwa salamu.
16.am: ጳውሎስ በኢየሩሳሌም ላሉት የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ስለሚሰበሰበው መዋጮ መመሪያ ይሰጣል፤ የጉዞ ዕቅዱንም ይነግራቸዋል። ጸንተው እንዲቆሙና ሁሉን በፍቅር እንዲያደርጉ ያበረታታቸዋል፤ በሰላምታም ይደመድማል።
